snippet.title: Only ONE Isn't 10p! 🪙 Riddle #16 Answer + Riddle #17: Socks in the Dark 🧦 #shorts
snippet.description:
Yesterday's riddle: two coins are worth 30p together, and one of them is NOT a 10p coin.
The trick: it only says ONE of them is not a 10p. That one is the 20p, and the other one is the 10p. 20p + 10p = 30p. ✅

Riddle #17 🧦
Power cut! Person 1 has to get ready in total darkness.
In the drawer: 10 black socks and 10 white socks, all mixed up.
Person 1 cannot see a thing, and needs just one matching pair.

How many socks must Person 1 take out to be SURE of a pair?
Comment 1, 2 or 3:
1) 2 socks
2) 3 socks
3) 11 socks
The answer drops tomorrow, at sunrise. ☀️

#riddle #riddles #brainteaser #puzzle #logicpuzzle #solvebysunrise #shorts
